sample.question: What ordering does a queue follow, and what do the enqueue and dequeue operations do?
sample.answer: A queue follows first in, first out (FIFO) ordering. Enqueue adds an item at the rear, and dequeue removes the oldest item from the front.
sample.sourceQuote: A queue follows first in, first out (FIFO) ordering.

sample.question: How does a stack differ from a queue in its ordering and operations?
sample.answer: A stack follows last in, first out (LIFO) ordering, where push adds an item and pop removes the most recently added item.
sample.sourceQuote: A stack instead follows last in, first out (LIFO) ordering.

sample.question: What happens when you enqueue into a full Aster queue or dequeue from an empty one?
sample.answer: Enqueue into a full Aster queue rejects the new item and preserves all existing items. Dequeue from an empty queue returns the sentinel EMPTY.
sample.sourceQuote: When the Aster queue is full, enqueue rejects the new item and preserves all existing items.

sample.question: What ordering rule does a queue follow?
sample.explanation: The document states that a queue follows first in, first out ordering, so the oldest item is removed first. Last in, first out describes a stack, not a queue.
sample.sourceQuote: A queue follows first in, first out (FIFO) ordering.

sample.question: Why does the circular buffer implementation also store a count of occupied slots?
options: It removes ambiguity when head and tail have the same value
It lets the buffer grow beyond its fixed capacity
It speeds up searching for an arbitrary item to O(1)
It makes enqueue and dequeue run in O(log n) time
sample.correctAnswer: It removes ambiguity when head and tail have the same value
sample.explanation: In a circular buffer, head and tail can hold the same index value in two different situations, and the count distinguishes empty from full. The count does not affect search speed or capacity, and the fixed-size operations are already O(1).
sample.sourceQuote: The count removes ambiguity when head and tail have the same value.
